name: Ketamine
tierNotes: Threshold: near-clean — the faintest softness only. (Bug fix: the profile used to also declare the SHARED generic doubleVision param, a horizontal two-tap diplopia baked into shared P2, running on top of this module's own bespoke vertical doubling — two independent double-vision effects stacking made everything feel doubled/blurred far earlier than intended. Removed; vertical doubling is the only diplopia now, and its own onset is pushed back besides.)

Light: still very close to clean; only acuity/desat/coolCast are perceptibly non-zero, and only just. A continuous low-amplitude baseline 'detachment drift' (gentle edge-tangent crawl + slow whole-frame breathing zoom, sigWarp) plus the shared breathing/drift/flowWarp trio (the same surfaces-bow-along-their-own-contours mechanics every other substance in the app uses for baseline life) are present from just past Threshold — small enough not to read as distortion, but enough that the render is never a dead static filter the way it was before this pass (feedback: 'Common shows no movement whatsoever... looks like a static filter').

Common: the baseline drift/breathing above is now clearly perceptible on its own — walls and surfaces visibly bow/crawl along their own contours; vertical doubling and painting-flattening begin in earnest partway through (their internal gates now start after Light, not at it); the shared organic patternMask (late curve — reused from LSD/DPH/opioid's own pattern layer, riding through ketamine's own cool/desaturated pipeline so it stays flat rather than reading as rainbow) starts contributing visible texture-pattern living in the image; world recession hasn't woken up yet.

Strong: world visibly shrinking inside a soft, breathing circular boundary; environmental cubism/scenery-slicing (PsychonautWiki's own documented ketamine geometry — 'algorithmic... synthetic... simplistic in complexity', milder and less intricate than a psychedelic fractal) is now strongly readable, its flat/posterized facets dominating over the underlying photo rather than lightly tinting it; hard-edge protection on mortar lines/object outlines is largely gone; breathing/drift/flowWarp and the patternMask texture-pattern are both near full strength, so the whole frame is continuously alive, not just the facets.

Heavy: full k-hole — recession and its breathing boundary are near maximum; cubism is pushed to its ceiling (flat/posterized facets are almost the entire visible content); above ~0.68 the receded painting's own structure visibly crawls/breathes along its contours via a real 2D domain-warp (not just edge-tangent creep), and above ~0.78 its colour gives way hard to a continuous, texture/luminance-masked pattern advected along those same contours — flat, posterized, desaturated-cool, tinted from the photo's own dominant palette. Ceilings raised after feedback that the source image was still clearly recognisable at Heavy: the goal is that it is not. (Bug fix: the dissolve's brightness-breathing pulse used to swing negative for part of every cycle; once the mask above could cover nearly the whole frame, that meant the ENTIRE render clamped to black for a real fraction of the loop — that's what read as 'Heavy just shows black.' The pulse is now always positive.) Takes inspiration from the psychedelics' structure-driven pattern language while staying in ketamine's own documented 'algorithmic'/low-complexity register, never LSD/DMT's rainbow or fractal tiling.
